scope: Nine actual large_enum_variant diagnostics in the r8 Agentd strict gate; nine owned source files, plus one explicitly delegated owning-consumer line in state_control.rs.

checks.runtime_validation: PENDING native owner strict/test/fmt on integrated final source; no pass claim from this audit.

changes.change: Box RootMaterialProfile in both enum carriers, wrap only the existing physical producers, and move *profile into the unchanged open call. Public and crate-owned entry signatures remain unchanged. LogicalOnly paths and require_existing_material remain untouched.

Box Rebind(CognitiveCheckpointReceipt) and Verified(MaterialRecord). Capture boxes only after the original second publisher.require_alive succeeds; Verify/Rebind map successful results into Box. observe unboxes before the same three field moves. The borrowed Rebind argument uses deref coercion.
changes.preserved: Bounded sync channel, occupied compare_exchange and release, deadline/timeout, publisher/lease/currentness checks, success/error mapping and response send order all remain outside the enumerated representation changes.

changes.change: Box only Observed.observation and OriginalNotesGrantObserved.effect_lease; wrap the two existing producers in admin_service/admin_effect. No new DTO, no other response field or variant change.
changes.serialization: The existing Debug, Serialize derives and status/snake_case serde tags are byte-identical. Box forwards Serialize to the same value. Field names, ordering, inner serializers, transport serde_json::to_vec(&response), frame handling and grant payloads are unchanged.
changes.layout_reasoning: Original diagnostic reports Observed payload 1200 bytes and OriginalNotesGrantObserved payload 593 bytes. Boxing only Observed would leave a second large gap. Exact source fields show AuthorityLeaseReadV1 is approximately 208 bytes on the diagnosed 64-bit target, so boxing this field reduces the second payload by about 200 bytes to about 393; OriginalNotesGrantRevocation remains about 336/344 bytes. These remainder figures are source-derived estimates, not newly measured layouts; the native strict gate is authoritative.

changes.change: Carry the existing Box<TaskFlowStepReceipt> directly through both AuthorizedEffectRecoveryResult producers. The sole owning consumer is effect_snapshot(*receipt) in state_control.rs, integrated by native_validation.
changes.preserved: Original auth/fence, durable recovery, status lookup, observation guard, settlement and error order unchanged; existing AuthorizedEffectExecution and earlier recovery boxing repairs are retained.

changes.scope: public Rust enums; Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, no serde derive
changes.change: Box PreparedAgentdIntelligenceRunV1 in both Ready carriers together. Sole prepared producer wraps the same struct; both admission paths forward the same Box. Existing borrowing/field-access test consumers and non-Ready paths need no edits.
changes.preserved: All envelope fields, candidate IDs, snapshot/context attachments, currentness calls, run admission ordering, signatures and canonical digest calculations are unchanged. Prior envelope: *envelope repair remains intact.

changes.scope: public Rust error enum; Debug, no serde derive
changes.change: Box the pending append carrier at its sole producer, after the same append result matches Indeterminate or Io. No in-repository owning pattern consumers were found in the full checkout map.
changes.preserved: Currentness validation before append, exact predecessor/snapshot/event contents, journal append ordering, reconciliation function signature and all other error branches unchanged.

source_api_impact.migration: External Rust code constructing these variants must wrap the payload; an owning consumer passing it to an unchanged unboxed API must move *payload. Existing borrowed access uses deref coercion. This is a Rust source API change, not a serialized protocol change.
source_api_impact.allocation_effect: The boxed carrier adds explicit heap allocation for newly constructed payloads and Clone of those payloads. Values, logical equality, debug values and ownership/drop semantics are preserved; allocation failure behavior is subject to the normal Box allocation contract.

prior_delta_preservation.proof: Candidate inverse reconstruction equals the current native input, not ancestor bef6fa.
Candidate inverse reconstruction equals the current native input, not ancestor bef6fa.

test_policy: No new behavior is introduced beyond explicit ownership indirection. Do not add implementation-mirroring tests; run the unchanged original strict gate and affected package tests on the integrated tree. All original assertions and tests are retained.
